literal: assembly having-known having-examined let-speak of-words collection who-knew purity they
translation: Let the pure who know the rich multitude of words examine their speech and deliver it with a clear understanding of the assembly.
modern: சொற்களின் வகைகளை அறிந்த தூய்மையானவர்கள், அவையின் தன்மையை அறிந்து ஆராய்ந்து பேச வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of understanding one's audience before speaking. The phrase 'சொல்லின் தொகை' refers to a rich vocabulary or the full range of words available to a speaker. The poet states that even those who possess this pure and vast knowledge of words must carefully examine what they are going to say. They must tailor their speech to suit the nature and capacity of the assembly they are addressing.
